name: Devout Chainlength
description: Blade hand on the left track and weight hand on the right, the student opens with both guarding the same front.

name: Weightswing Decree
description: The kama slices down the left track and its hook ends at the opponent's near wrist.

name: Kusaridecree
description: The weight darts out along the right track in a straight line and returns on the same path.

name: Tanglepledge
description: The weight changes from the right track to the left mid-throw and wraps the arm that moved to meet it.

name: Undaunted Weightball
description: Chain and haft lie parallel in front of the body and shed a blow down the line between them.

name: Thunderclap Tangle
description: The kama crosses over from its own track to the weight's and cuts where the guard had just moved from.

name: Sigilkusari
description: Chain and hook press the opponent's weapon from two sides at once and hold it until the student releases.

name: Statute Ballbind
description: Weight and thrown kama travel down parallel lines in rapid turns, giving the opponent no clear moment to step in.

name: Kusariverdict
description: Both tracks fold together on one point and the guard they met breaks, taking the opponent's balance with it.

name: Harmonious Season Lashcut
description: Blade and weight answer each other in alternating strokes, each leading the opponent's guard into the next, as the school teaches.

name: Braced Chainloop
description: On the raised heel with chain overhead, the student guards like a hawk on a high post.

name: Bedrock Rodhandle
description: From a high stance the kama falls in a long slash at the opponent's crown or collarbone.

name: Pulsarsnare
description: Two short tosses of the weight follow each other at the same height and divide the guard.

name: Peal Sicklehook
description: The student stands still and lets the chain's slight pulls report where the opponent shifts weight.

name: Thrall Tangknob
description: The chain draws a circle in the air and settles it around the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Kusaricrown
description: A feather-light parry with the haft turns into a quick counter slash at the exposed forearm.

name: Sickleblade Vow
description: The student drops half into a dive and rises again, drawing the opponent's guard low for nothing.

name: Sigil Sicklepull
description: The chain is thrown wide and drawn closed by the hook like a net over the opponent's upper body.

name: Millstone Chainkey
description: Weight and kama stoop in turn from either hand at the opponent's guard and keep it low.

name: Interstice Snare
description: The student leaps in a flash above the guard and cuts down from the other side.

name: Gallant Inferno Weightswing
description: The court's closing stroke: after circling above, the student falls with kama and weight together on the opponent's one weak side.

name: Prismkusari
description: The student stands curved like a river bend with the kama on the outside and the chain looped within.

name: Vigorsickle
description: The hook flows around the guard's edge in one curved line and cuts the arm behind it.

name: Thunderclap Entwine
description: The weight follows the line the opponent's own movement opens, like a floating leaf finding the current.

name: Silken Chainlength
description: Light, deliberate steps cross the opponent's line of attack like stones across a ford.

name: Peremptory Sickleblade
description: The chain curves in from the side like water along a bank and winds about the leading leg.

name: Tanglecrown
description: A retreating turn becomes an eddy that swings the weight back to hit the pursuing opponent.

name: Deluge Tangknob
description: The chain parts a straight cut as a rock parts a stream and sends it harmlessly to both sides.

name: Phantasm Pommelring
description: Chain trailing slack among the student's feet hides the moment it will snap straight.

name: Statute Rodhandle
description: A churn of fast casts and returns keeps the opponent from stepping into the student's range.

name: Sicklehook Troth
description: Chain wound in a spinning spiral draws the opponent inward and the kama waits at the centre.

name: Tempestuous Pommelring
description: The weight and kama sweep in wide overlapping casts that cover the ground like a spreading flood.

name: Thunderclap Snare
description: Loop upon loop of chain flows around the guard and gathers in the weight, which lands at one chosen point.

name: Sturdy Ballbind
description: Two sweeps of chain, one outside the other, make two rims between student and opponent.

name: Snarebanner
description: The hook cuts the outer rim of the opponent's guard, drawing its attention to the edge.

name: Paramount Lashcut
description: The weight follows the hook and strikes at the inner rim the cut had uncovered.

name: Masterful Sicklepull
description: Two arcs of chain, high and low, close on the opponent from opposite sides and bind both arms.

name: Deluge Chainkey
description: A parry on the outer rim is followed by a second on the inner one, taking a heavy blow in two stages.

name: Majestic Tangle
description: The weight swings in a full circle and spills over the opponent's shoulder at the top of its turn.

name: Entwine Troth
description: Two hooks of the chain press the opponent's weapon into the ground and hold it there.

name: Seasonkusari
description: Casts go out beyond the opponent's reach and return, filling the space so that they cannot advance.

name: Kusaribanner
description: Kama and weight strike the same edge of a guard from both rims and cut through it.

name: Heroic Magma Chainlength
description: The student draws the two rims together in one full circle that closes on everything inside the basin.

name: Bedrock Chainloop
description: Standing where two lines of chain would meet, the student holds the high ground above them.

name: Steeltangle
description: The hook slashes down from above the shoulder like a flood cresting over a weir.

name: Pommelring Banner
description: Two throws, one on each side of the opponent, travel on separate lines toward the same point.

name: Luminous Ballbind
description: A touch of the weight on both of the opponent's sides tells the student which hand is strongest.

name: Tyrannous Lashcut
description: The chain forks around the opponent's arms and closes again behind them.

name: Sicklehook Verdict
description: The weight is cast out and comes back downstream of the opponent's guard, striking its open rear.

name: Phantasm Sicklepull
description: The student shows a cast against the flow, then reverses it and strikes the unguarded side.

name: Chainloop Pledge
description: A whirling screen of chain stands above the water-line of the opponent's attack and turns it high.

name: Sigilsickle
description: The hook parts the opponent's two arms like two rivers and the weight strikes the chest between them.

name: Season Weightball
description: In a flash the student crosses the gap between two chains and falls on the opponent from the far bank.

name: Symphonic Volition Snare
description: Two streams of chain and cut run apart, then join at the opponent in one final stroke the school calls the kill.

name: Sturdy Chainkey
description: The student holds still around a settled Core, kama and chain steady and without any strain.

name: Steel Entwine
description: The Core's power is carried to the blade's edge in a single drawing cut.

name: Magnificent Weightball
description: The weight is driven from the Core outward along the chain and lands with the force of a thrown stone.

name: Feather Rodhandle
description: A broad, sure pace sets the student at the far end of the reaping arc with the chain trailing clear.

name: Cording Tangle
description: A pulse from the Core runs down the chain and tightens its coils around the opponent in one beat.

name: Peal Weightball
description: The chain is held up smooth and taut like a mirror and sends a cut back along its own line.

name: Pealsnare
description: The hook, warmed by Core qi, bites deep and hauls the opponent's weapon off its line.

name: Peal Pommelring
description: The student matches breath to the chain's sway and feels the rhythm of the opponent's own breath through it.

name: Volition Chainlength
description: Weight casts at every opening of a guard keep the opponent pinned under a clear and open sky.

name: Sicklepledge
description: Chain is strung in a lattice of crossing lines and charged by the Core to catch what enters it.

name: Ethereal Sickleblade
description: The Core carries the student in a flash to the opponent's side, where the kama point drives through plate.

name: Imperious Tangle
description: The school's great reaping: a sky-wide sweep of kama and weight, gathered in one breath and loosed across the whole field.

name: Statute Tangknob
description: The student faces the wind with the kama held open at the side and the chain trailing freely behind.

name: Vigor Lashcut
description: The hook cuts straight into the wind and the blade's edge rides its push.

name: Prism Sickleblade
description: With the palm open to the gale, the weight is carried out on the wind in a swift, flat line.

name: Millstone Entwine
description: The wind holds the chain's end out straight and the weight then loops round the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Paritysickle
description: Leaning into a gust, the student lets the chain bow and carry an incoming cut away.

name: Matchless Rodhandle
description: A gust turns the cast weight back on its own line and the kama cuts as it arrives.

name: Phantasm Tangknob
description: Dust lifted by a gust and the chain's rattle together hide which hand will move.

name: Volition Sicklehook
description: Casts follow one another on the wind so fast that the opponent keeps to cover.

name: Millstone Chainloop
description: The hook and chain tangle the opponent's weapon and the student holds the tangle against the wind's pull.

name: Pulsarkusari
description: The student rides a gust in a flash across the gap and cuts at the end of it.

name: Resonant Chainkey Decree
description: Cuts, casts and hauls are carried openly into the wind in one rolling run that the wind-sworn schools pass on.

name: Bedrock Ballbind
description: The student plants both feet on a line and holds the kama across it, sworn not to give the ground.

name: Steel Sicklepull
description: The hook slices along the held line and does not stray beyond it.

name: Kusariedict
description: The weight is cast along the line to meet anyone who crosses it.

name: Thrall Sicklepull
description: The chain whips around the leg of an opponent who steps over the line and holds them there.

name: Delugekusari
description: A parry made without moving the feet turns the cut away and the line stays unbroken.

name: Intrepid Chainloop
description: The weight snaps back along the line and the kama cuts the reaching hand.

name: Majestic Chainlength
description: Casts land one after another along the oath line and none may cross it.

name: Torquing Tangknob
description: The hook pins the opponent's blade to the ground and the weight swings in at the freed flank.

name: Prism Weightball
description: The reap breaks through a guard that had held for several strokes in one clean pass.

name: Entwine Edict
description: A sweeping stroke along the sworn line that no one standing on it can leave unhurt, as the school teaches.

name: Pommelring Covenant
description: The student sets one shoulder to the wind and holds the chain tight behind the kama.

name: Quenched Weightswing
description: The hook is drawn along a bearing taken before the stroke, with no deviation at the end.

name: Radiance Chainkey
description: The weight is thrown into the headwind so that it slows and drops steeply onto the target.

name: Snare Grace
description: The student steps squarely forward against the wind, keeping the chain tight at the hip.

name: Sigiltangle
description: The chain is cast up wind and the wind helps its end to curl around the target.

name: Kamatroth
description: The chain rolls over the cut along the user's own bearing and passes it by.

name: Sickletroth
description: A hooked weapon is pulled back against the wind and its owner is made to stumble.

name: Snaretroth
description: The user lets a gust at the back push a false cast forward, then answers with the true one.

name: Seasontangle
description: Heavy low casts against the wind hold the opponent where they stand, unable to advance.

name: Destiny Tangle
description: The student advances into the wind with a running chain of casts and cuts that never loses its bearing.

name: Lashcut Grace
description: In one flash against the wind the student closes the distance and cuts, then stands beyond the opponent.

name: Royal Sicklehook
description: The school's great stroke: kama and weight reap the whole front into the wind in a single gathered sweep.

name: Consecrated Sickleblade
description: With nothing behind or beside, the student guards all sides by turning slowly with the chain.

name: Snaredecree
description: The hook cuts upward through the opponent's guard and finishes high above the head.

name: Vaunted Snare
description: The weight is cast at an opponent in the open, with the whole sky behind it.

name: Lashing Rodhandle
description: A wide cast circles the opponent in the open and the chain closes around the legs.

name: Rodhandle Covenant
description: The chain swings out to cover the student's open flank and turns a cut that would have landed.

name: Haemaltangle
description: The weight swings wide and returns on a far line, taking the opponent from behind.

name: Pallsnare
description: The student turns as if to flee across the bare plain and then whirls the weight back at the pursuer.

name: Volition Sicklepull
description: Casts go out on all bearings in turn and keep the whole field under the student's control.

name: Kamavow
description: A chain pegged low in the grass closes around the ankle of whoever runs across it.

name: Pulsartangle
description: With nothing to stop it, the student flashes across the plain and reaps once at the end.

name: Valiant Entropy Chainkey
description: The school's last stroke: one turning reap that clears the open plain around the student of every foe.

name: Statute Weightball
description: The student stands braced against the wind with the chain steady and the kama low, holding the oath.

name: Snaretriumph
description: The kama slices across the wind on a line the wind itself cannot bend.

name: Paramount Pommelring
description: The weight is cast along a fixed oath-line and holds true through the strongest gust.

name: Thrall Ballbind
description: A coil of chain closes around the opponent and is held shut by the user's steady grip.

name: Sainted Chainloop
description: The parry is made without a step, so the student keeps the place they swore to hold.

name: Thunderclap Sicklehook
description: The wind brings the weight back to the student's hand and the kama cuts in the same breath.

name: Prism Tangknob
description: Chain whirls in a constant ring against the gale and keeps thrown iron from reaching the student.

name: Wringing Weightswing
description: Chain and hook press the opponent down and the oath-steady student keeps up the pressure.

name: Interstice Sickleblade
description: On a gust the student flashes to the opponent's side and reaps once.

name: Sovereign Weightswing
description: The school's sworn stroke: a single cast on a held bearing that reaches its mark whatever the wind does.

name: Unwavering Chainlength
description: The student stands settled around the Core, kama and chain steady in the wind.

name: Vigor Entwine
description: Core power rides the blade's edge in a single drawing cut through the wind.

name: Pulsar Lashcut
description: The weight flies from the Core's push along the chain to land at the sworn point.

name: Squall Tangle
description: A long, even pace placed on the sworn bearing carries the student forward without wavering.

name: Sigil Snare
description: The Core's steady power draws the wrapped chain tight about the opponent's arm.

name: Pallsickle
description: The chain rides the wind and the Core's power together to turn a blow aside.

name: Subjugating Weightswing
description: The hook sets and the student hauls with the Core's strength, pulling a weapon from the opponent's hands.

name: Tranquil Chainloop
description: Wind and Core together tell the student the drift and force of the gale for the next cast.

name: Bedrock Weightball
description: A fan of Core-driven casts keeps the whole opposing line from advancing.

name: Pulsar Pommelring
description: Chain is laid in a lattice across open ground and held taut by the Core to catch whoever enters.

name: Pulsarsickle
description: The student flashes down the line of the gale and the kama's point drives through plate.

name: Chainlength Verdict
description: The school's sworn great reaping: kama and weight gathered in one breath and loosed across the whole windy field.
